territory: VLM/dense prediction: vision-language models for dense tasks, grounding, referring segmentation, pixel-level alignment between text and image features
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, core_claim, method_sketch, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, novelty_hook, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, kill_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label). Alias fields mirror their counterparts per shard_format convention: core_claim=core_hypothesis, method_sketch=minimal_falsification_experiment, novelty_hook=why_possibly_novel, kill_risk=main_risk. Every candidate answers: what the community assumes (community_default_belief), why it may be wrong (why_it_might_be_wrong), and the fastest falsifying experiment (fastest_falsifying_experiment).

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or claimed experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows dirs created; no Windows numbers scanned.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 101 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard near-duplicates were minimized by design but conceptual neighbors remain for dedup review: vlmd-0021 vs vlmd-0074 (shortcut/baseline audits of referring vs reasoning benchmarks), vlmd-0050 vs vlmd-0052 (synonym renaming vs prompt-overfitting leakage), vlmd-0068 vs vlmd-0069 (paraphrase-based ambiguity detection vs paraphrase-based uncertainty estimation), vlmd-0008 vs vlmd-0022 vs vlmd-0084 (negation handling at alignment, benchmark, and efficiency levels).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-01 (SAM/PEFT: prompt/decoder adaptation, forgetting), genA-07 (benchmark weaknesses: evaluation_benchmark_hygiene cluster), and genA-08 (uncertainty: uncertainty_calibration_dense cluster); dedup should treat those cluster tags as high-collision zones.

vlmd-0090 and vlmd-0093 require small-scale pretraining runs whose external validity at production scale is flagged inside the records; vlmd-0036 depends on access to open pretraining corpora for contamination analysis.
